name: Isometric Key Grid
description: An interactive 3D background for React and three.js: an isometric field of soft keys that rise in a smooth dome under the cursor, light up in a flowing gradient and glow onto the floor, each with a small line icon. Two draw calls; it rests when idle.

props.name: colors
props.description: Four colours for the gradient that flows over raised keys and glows on the floor.

props.name: keyColor
props.description: Colour of the keys at rest.

props.name: lift
props.description: How high the key under the pointer rises, in key heights.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the raised area, in key spacings.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Icon size as a share of a key.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between keys, as a share of a key's width. 0 packs them edge to edge.

props.name: keySize
props.description: Size of the keys on screen. 1 is the default zoom; higher values make every key (and its icon) bigger, so fewer fit.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
